question: In the United States, for Q4 2019 and Q4 2020, first select only those cities where total sales (with no promotions) rose by at least 20% from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020. Among these cities, rank products by their overall sales (still excluding promotions) in those quarters and take the top 20%. Then compute each top product’s share of total sales in Q4 2019 and Q4 2020 and calculate the difference in share from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020, returning the results in descending order of that share change.
sql:
WITH city_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        c.cust_city, 
        t.calendar_quarter_desc as quarter,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE c.country_id = 52790
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND t.calendar_quarter_desc IN ('2019-04', '2020-04')
    GROUP BY c.cust_city, t.calendar_quarter_desc
),
city_growth AS (
    SELECT 
        cust_city,
        total_sales_2019,
        total_sales_2020,
        (total_sales_2020 - total_sales_2019) * 1.0 / total_sales_2019 as growth_rate
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            cust_city,
            SUM(CASE WHEN quarter = '2019-04' THEN total_sales ELSE 0 END) as total_sales_2019,
            SUM(CASE WHEN quarter = '2020-04' THEN total_sales ELSE 0 END) as total_sales_2020
        FROM city_sales
        GROUP BY cust_city
    )
    WHERE total_sales_2019 > 0
),
qualifying_cities AS (
    SELECT cust_city
    FROM city_growth
    WHERE growth_rate >= 0.20
),
product_city_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        c.cust_city,
        p.prod_id,
        t.calendar_quarter_desc as quarter,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as prod_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN products p ON s.prod_id = p.prod_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE c.country_id = 52790
      AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND t.calendar_quarter_desc IN ('2019-04', '2020-04')
    GROUP BY c.cust_city, p.prod_id, t.calendar_quarter_desc
),
product_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN quarter = '2019-04' THEN prod_sales ELSE 0 END) as sales_2019,
        SUM(CASE WHEN quarter = '2020-04' THEN prod_sales ELSE 0 END) as sales_2020,
        SUM(prod_sales) as total_sales
    FROM product_city_sales
    GROUP BY prod_id
),
product_ranking AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        sales_2019,
        sales_2020,
        total_sales,
        NTILE(100) OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) as percentile_rank
    FROM product_totals
),
top_20_percent AS (
    SELECT prod_id, sales_2019, sales_2020
    FROM product_ranking
    WHERE percentile_rank <= 20
),
city_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        quarter,
        SUM(prod_sales) as city_total
    FROM product_city_sales
    GROUP BY quarter
),
product_shares AS (
    SELECT 
        p.prod_id,
        p.sales_2019,
        p.sales_2020,
        p.sales_2019 * 1.0 / c2019.city_total as share_2019,
        p.sales_2020 * 1.0 / c2020.city_total as share_2020,
        (p.sales_2019 * 1.0 / c2019.city_total) - (p.sales_2020 * 1.0 / c2020.city_total) as share_change
    FROM top_20_percent p
    JOIN city_totals c2019 ON c2019.quarter = '2019-04'
    JOIN city_totals c2020 ON c2020.quarter = '2020-04'
)
SELECT 
    prod_id,
    share_2019,
    share_2020,
    share_change
FROM product_shares
ORDER BY share_change DESC
